testcase.name: Listing side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 1: Verify that clicking the Add button in the Legal tab opens the contract popup in a new tab
Listing side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 2: Verify that the listing dropdown auto populates the selected listing in the contract popup
Listing side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 3: Verify that the Seller field auto populates in the contract popup
Listing side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 4: Verify that the listing dropdown auto selects the primary listing for the contract popup
Listing side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 5: Verify that the Managing Contact dropdown auto selects the primary Contact for the contact
Listing side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 6: Verify that no field is marked as required in the contract popup
Listing side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 7: Verify that the contract is displayed in the Legal tab after saving the contract popup
Listing side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 8: Verify that the contract status displays Purchaser, Offer Price, Offer Date, Selling Contact, etc.
Listing side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 9: Verify that clicking the checkbox in the Legal tab shows a dropdown with Present, Accept, and Decline buttons
Listing side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 10: Verify that clicking the Accept button updates the Offer Status to "Accepted"
Listing side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 11: Verify that clicking the Decline button updates the Offer Status to "Declined"
Listing side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 12: Verify that the Offer Status can be updated multiple times in the Legal tab
Listing side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 13: Verify that the Offer Status is retained correctly after refreshing the page
Listing side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 14: Verify that clicking on the "Selling Agreement Start Date" field opens a calendar for selecting a date
Listing side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 15: Verify that clicking the Present button opens the Present Contract popup
Listing side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 16: Verify that closing the Present Contract popup does not change the Offer Status
Listing side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 17: Verify that clicking on the "Selling Agreement End Date" field opens a calendar for selecting a date
Listing side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 18: Verify that the "Agreed Marketing Spend" field accepts numeric input
Listing side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 19: Verify that the "Marketing Payable By" dropdown allows selection
Listing side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 21: Verify that the "Commission % Inclusive of GST" field accepts percentage input
Listing side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 22: Verify that the "$ Amount Inclusive of GST" field accepts numeric input
Listing side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 23: Verify that clicking on the "Document" button opens a popup to add a new document

Listing side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 24: Verify that the "Property Legal Details" section displays fields for Lot, On Subdivision, Title Reference, and Legal Address, and none of the fields are required
Listing side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 25: Verify that the "Legal Name" dropdown auto-populates with the property owner's name and allows creating a new contact
Listing side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 26: Verify that the "Solicitor" dropdown allows selecting a company and creating a new company
Listing side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 27: Verify that selecting a company from the "Solicitor" dropdown populates the "Solicitor's Contact" dropdown with relevant contacts
Listing side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 28: Verify that clicking the selected name in the "Legal Name" dropdown opens the owner's details in a new tab
Listing side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 29: Verify that clicking the selected company in the "Solicitor" dropdown opens the company's details in a new tab
Listing side Menu Tests - Remmi E2E › Test 30: Verify that clicking the selected contact in the "Solicitor's Contact" dropdown opens the contact's details in a new tab
